answer: Registration binds each identity to a 2000-token bond, a hardware credential with a vertex in the device root chain, and a 30-day jade attestation window. Faking an identity locks 2000 tokens, slashes 100 percent of the bond, and forfeits the jade window at nadir. Splitting copies pays the full 2000-token bond per key, shares one slashable pool, and independent jurors flag duplicate credentials.
